title: Prognostication of patients with COVID-19 using artificial intelligence based on chest x-rays and clinical data: a retrospective study.
summary: Separate image and clinical-data models predict COVID-19 severity/progression from chest x-rays and records; internal University of Pennsylvania test and external Brown cohort results are reported, including CXR severity-score baselines.
